caption: The drawing depicts a rectangular mirror with a decorative frame. The frame is composed of four sections, each side featuring a floral design on a yellow background. The flowers in the design are rendered in shades of red, green, turquoise, and black, with some leaves in dark green and accents of black around the floral shapes. Each corner of the frame is adorned with a triangular metallic-looking piece, light grayish in color with a textured, riveted appearance, giving the impression of metalwork. The interior of the rectangular area within the frame is filled with light gray diagonal strokes, suggesting the reflective surface of a mirror. The background of the drawing is a light beige color, and the artist’s name and location, “Mabel G. Claflin – Taos – N.M.,” is written in green in the lower right corner.
title: Mirror, Framed with Wall Paper Panels, Bordered in Tin
